stem: In Q2 Voltmarkt sold 60 HDMI cables at a margin of €10 each and 40 phone chargers at a margin of €5 each. In Q3 it sold 70 cables and 60 chargers. In Voltmarkt's margin bridge, the volume effect is the change in total units times the average Q2 margin per unit, weighted by Q2 units. What is the volume effect from Q2 to Q3? Give it in euros as a whole number.
